title: Part 3: JavaScript
summary: Add interactivity: DOM manipulation, event listeners, and interactive features.
content:
# JavaScript Interactivity: Bringing the Portfolio to Life

JavaScript adds behavior to your site. It lets users toggle controls, validate forms, and interact with elements on the page.

## Core Ideas

### DOM Manipulation
Use JavaScript to find elements, update text, add classes, and respond to user actions.

### Event Listeners
Attach listeners to buttons, menus, and form controls so the page reacts when people click, type, or submit.

### State and Storage
Some features should remember user choices, like dark mode or menu visibility. `localStorage` is a simple way to keep that state.

### Progressive Enhancement
Build the page so it works without JavaScript first, then layer interactivity on top.

## Your Task
Add useful interactivity to the portfolio, such as dark mode, a mobile menu, and contact form validation.

tasks.title: Dark mode
tasks.instructions: Add a dark mode toggle that persists in localStorage.

tasks.title: Mobile menu
tasks.instructions: Implement a mobile menu toggle using JS.

tasks.title: Form validation
tasks.instructions: Validate the contact form before submission.

hints: Keep behavior progressive and avoid over-reliance on frameworks.
